## Body

The request body is **required**.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `country` | `string` | **yes** | ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 |
| `regime` | `string` | no | Only `gst` splits by place of supply. One of `gst`, `vat`, `sales_tax`, `flat`. |

| `tax_profile_id` | `string` | no | Defaults to the business default profile |
| `home_state_code` | `string` | no | The SELLER's state — decides intra vs inter state supply |

| `registration_number` | `string` | no | The seller's tax registration number. |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type. |
| `id` | `string` | The tax region's id (txg_…). |
| `tax_profile_id` | `string` | The id of the tax profile the region belongs to (txp_…). |
| `country` | `string` | The region's country (ISO-3166 alpha-2 code). |
| `regime` | `string` | The tax regime. One of `gst`, `vat`, `sales_tax`, `flat`. |
| `price_type` | `string` | Whether prices include tax or tax is added on top. One of `exclusive`, `inclusive`. |
| `home_state_code` | `string` | The seller's home state code. |
| `registration_label` | `string` | The label for the tax registration number, e.g. `gstin`. |
| `registration_number` | `string` | The seller's tax registration number. |
| `collect_registration_number` | `boolean` | Whether to ask the customer for a tax registration number. |
| `reverse_charge_enabled` | `boolean` | Whether the reverse charge applies in this region. |
| `show_reverse_charge_note` | `boolean` | Whether the reverse charge note is printed on invoices. |
| `reverse_charge_note` | `string` | The note printed on invoices for a reverse charge. |
| `sez_igst_enabled` | `boolean` | Whether sales to a special economic zone are charged IGST. |
| `sez_igst_note` | `string` | The note printed on invoices for an IGST sale to a special economic zone. |
| `sez_zero_rated_enabled` | `boolean` | Whether sales to a special economic zone are zero-rated. |
| `sez_zero_rated_note` | `string` | The note printed on invoices for a zero-rated sale to a special economic zone. |
| `export_igst_enabled` | `boolean` | Whether export sales are charged IGST. |
| `export_igst_note` | `string` | The note printed on invoices for an IGST export sale. |
| `export_zero_rated_enabled` | `boolean` | Whether export sales are zero-rated. |
| `export_zero_rated_note` | `string` | The note printed on invoices for a zero-rated export sale. |
| `enabled` | `boolean` | True if the region is enabled. |
| `allowed_tax_treatments` | `array of string` | The treatments a customer in this region may be assigned, derived from the gates above. |
| `components` | `array of object` | The tax region's components. |
| `state_registrations` | `array of object` | The tax region's state registrations. |
| `created_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the region was created (ISO-8601 UTC). |
